Tidying Your Digital Life

For anyone whose phone, computer and inbox feel as cluttered as a junk drawer. Each day is one small way to clear old files, sort photos, quiet alerts and organize accounts, so your digital life feels lighter and easier to find your way around.

Habits · Habits · Stress · one to-do a day · you choose how many days

Start this challenge free

The first seven days

  • Day 1Open your photos, smile at the first picture you see, then delete just one blurry shot nearby.
  • Day 2Unsubscribe from one email list you always delete without reading.
  • Day 3Pick one app you have not opened in ages, delete it, and enjoy the little bit of space it leaves behind.
  • Day 4Jot down on paper three online accounts you know you no longer use, and leave it at that for now.
  • Day 5Notice one corner of your digital life that already feels tidy, and let yourself enjoy it for a moment.
  • Day 6Scan one old paper photo with your phone and save it in a family album with the year it was taken.
  • Day 7Archive email threads from last year that are finished and need nothing more from you.

Further into the year

The to-dos keep changing as the year goes on. A few from later in this theme:

  • Day 30Remind yourself kindly that digital clutter builds up for everyone, and a little at a time is plenty.
  • Day 60Copy a kind message from a friend into a paper journal by hand.
  • Day 120Invite a friend to share their favorite photo of the two of you.
  • Day 240Keep a little list of the tidy tasks you found pleasant, to return to on low energy days.
  • Day 365End a tidy by closing your laptop gently and stepping away to do something you enjoy.

How a challenge works

A Theraglee challenge is a theme with one small to-do for every day of a year. You choose how long yours runs, anywhere from a week to the full year, and each day you get the next to-do: something that takes a few minutes and fits inside an ordinary day. Tick it off when it is done. Nothing is scored and nothing is lost if you miss a day; the next to-do is simply waiting when you come back.

Challenges come with a free Theraglee account, which never asks for a card. Your progress stays private to you.
